implementation: max_experiment_seconds is checked before admitting each atomic 3000 FE run, using sum of search and final-metric seconds plus reproduction search seconds.
granularity: An already admitted run is completed and recorded; the total may exceed the cap by at most its runtime. No new run is admitted after the cap is exceeded. No extension or threshold relaxation is authorized.
not_included: Unit tests, independent integrity reevaluations, data loading/object construction, JSON persistence and agent analysis time are separate.
final_report_requirement: Report exact measured total and any overshoot, and list incomplete method/case/seed combinations.
